1.

Thee, O Jesus, now our song we raise, Thou who hast loved us without cause, And for Thee now our knees we bow; Thou hast redeemed us and done it well.

2.

All our sins Thou hast put away, Thou Lamb of God without spot or blemish, With Thy precious blood hast cleansed us; Lord Jesus, all Thou hast done well.

3.

Whatsoever befalls here on the pilgrim path, We may praise Thee, Immanuel, Sing in joy, beneath the tears: All Thou doest, Thou doest, Lord, well!

4.

Thou hast gone away to prepare us a place In Thy Father’s blissful home, yet still Thy Spirit shall lead us so surely; Lord, Thou shalt make all things well.

5.

And when time’s toil is past, We shall as with one soul To Thy glory sing this song: Lord Jesus, all Thou hast done well!
